countries.name: United States
countries.note: No national VAT; local sales tax added at register. Look up by ZIP.

countries.name: Germany
countries.note: Non-EU visitors can reclaim VAT (Global Blue / Planet) when leaving the EU.

countries.name: United Kingdom
countries.note: Tourist VAT refund scheme was abolished in 2021.

countries.name: Switzerland
countries.note: Refund available above a minimum receipt value, claimed at the border.

countries.name: UAE
countries.note: Planet Tax Free refund at airport kiosks for tourists.

countries.name: Japan
countries.note: Tax-free shopping at point of sale for tourists with passport.

countries.name: Singapore
countries.note: eTRS refund at Changi Airport for tourists.

countries.name: India
countries.note: No tourist GST refund scheme.

countries.name: Australia
countries.note: Tourist Refund Scheme (TRS) refunds nearly the full GST over AUD 300.

countries.name: Hong Kong
countries.note: No sales tax in Hong Kong — the price Apple shows is the price paid.

countries.name: Canada
countries.note: Visitor rebate discontinued in 2007. Pick a province separately.

countries.name: Taiwan
countries.note: Apple's prices include the 5% VAT; tourists can claim a refund on qualifying purchases.

countries.name: Macau
countries.note: Apple's Macau shop pages aren't publicly available, so no Apple prices can be read for Macau.

countries.name: South Korea
countries.note: Tax refund kiosks (Global Blue) at Incheon for tourists on qualifying purchases.

countries.name: Malaysia
countries.note: Smartphones are currently exempt from Malaysia's Sales & Service Tax.

countries.name: Thailand
countries.note: VAT refund for tourists at the airport on departure, above a minimum spend.

countries.name: Qatar
countries.note: Apple has no online store in Qatar, so there are no Apple prices to read.

countries.name: New Zealand
countries.note: No tourist GST refund scheme, unlike neighbouring Australia.

countries.name: Mexico
countries.note: IVA refund available to tourists at the airport for purchases over a minimum amount.

countries.name: Saudi Arabia
countries.note: Tourist VAT refund available at the airport for eligible visitors since 2021.

catalog_meta.source: apple.com — each country's own Apple online store
